---
title: "FishSET GUI Quickstart Guide"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{FishSET GUI Quickstart Guide}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# 1. Try to find the file in the installed package
guide_path <- system.file("extdata", "FishSET_GUI_Quickstart_Content.html", package = "FishSET")

# 2. Fallback for clicking "Knit" in RStudio before installing the package
if (guide_path == "") {
  guide_path <- "../inst/extdata/FishSET_GUI_Quickstart_Content.html"
}

# 3. Include the HTML AND force Pandoc to load FontAwesome
htmltools::tagList(
  fontawesome::fa_html_dependency(),
  htmltools::includeHTML(guide_path)
)
```
